categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in four business segments: audio-video software products and solutions, system integration and services, game and cloud services, and VR business products and services. It focuses on providing end-to-end video solutions for the broadcasting industry, system integration for broadcasting networks, IPTV game development and operation, and VR/MR content production and operation.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including ultra-high-definition (4K/8K) video processing, cloud computing, AI-driven content recommendation, VR/AR/MR immersive technologies, SLAM positioning, real-time rendering, and microservices architecture for software platforms. It develops proprietary hardware like the LOOPS CAM 180°/8K VR camera and integrates AI and large model technologies for virtual social and immersive experiences.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are provincial broadcasting network operators, China Broadcasting Network, the three major telecom operators (China Mobile, China Unicom, China Telecom), and internet content platforms such as iQIYI and CCTV. The company serves the broadcasting, telecommunications, cultural tourism, education, and government sectors, focusing on large-scale broadcasting network upgrades and emerging VR/AR content markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant business in regions including North China, East China, South China, Central China, Southwest, and Northwest China. It has established pilot VR/MR experience stores in Beijing and plans expansion to Shanghai, Shenzhen, Chengdu, Xi'an, and other cities. It also has a wholly-owned subsidiary in Hong Kong.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily midstream and downstream in the supply chain, providing software platforms, system integration services, content production, and end-user VR/AR experiences. It integrates upstream hardware components from partners but focuses on software development, system deployment, and content operation for broadcasting and telecom operators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include technology-driven upgrades in 5G, cloud computing, AI, and immersive media; expanding product and service diversification including SaaS/PaaS cloud services and virtual social platforms; optimizing business structure and operational models; expanding domestic and international markets especially along the Belt and Road; integrating the industry chain through mergers and partnerships; and enhancing internal management and risk control. R&D focuses on ultra-high-definition video cloud platforms, ultra-low latency streaming, AI-powered metaverse audiovisual interaction systems, IPTV games, and MR/AR large space content products.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of software products and system integration services to broadcasting and telecom operators. Additional revenue streams include game development and licensing, cloud service subscriptions and cooperation, VR/MR content production and operation, and customized development fees for virtual simulation and digital human projects. The company also earns from government subsidies and investment income such as debt restructuring gains.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading provider of comprehensive digital TV system solutions and audio-video platforms in the Chinese broadcasting industry. It competes with other broadcasting system integrators and software providers, leveraging its broad product line, deep industry experience, and technical advantages in low latency, high bandwidth, and large-scale content distribution. The VR content and game market is fragmented with many small players; the company aims to consolidate and lead in MR/AR immersive content.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 149.15 million, a 14.16% increase year-over-year, but a net loss of RMB 58.05 million, with a reduced loss margin. The company maintains high R&D investment at about 16.83% of revenue. Total assets decreased by 35.87% to RMB 236.58 million, and net assets attributable to shareholders dropped by 68.18% to RMB 27.11 million. The company faces ongoing profitability challenges but is actively restructuring and investing in growth areas.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive end-to-end video and broadcasting solutions with strong technical innovation, including ultra-high-definition video, ultra-low latency streaming, and immersive VR/AR/MR content. It offers integrated platforms supporting multiple terminals and AI-driven personalized content recommendations. Its deep industry knowledge, extensive client base in broadcasting, and strategic partnerships enable it to deliver reliable, scalable, and innovative solutions tailored to the evolving needs of broadcasting and telecom operators.
